subject: give a conditional panel a label for use in a .css file

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: give a conditional panel a label for use in a .css file
parts:
Hello,
 I have a Shiny application which has several conditional panels in the side panel of the ui.r. By default each conditional panel is displayed in its own <div>. If I inspect the element I get:  div data-display-if="input.ThreshPoint" style="display: block;"  where input.ThreshPoint indicates if a certain check box is checked ro not. I would like to change this to an inline display, but I cannot tell how I should refer to this. using #data-display-if="input.ThreshPoint" did not work. What is the best way to procede? I am using a ui.r to buidl the interface rather than an html ui - is that the issue?

Thanks
JP

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: Re: give a conditional panel a label for use in a .css file
parts:
To reply to my own problem - in the conditonalPanel() function you can add a id="name" or class="name" option, which will give you an id or class than can be used for css purposes.

JP
